concepts.definition: F11 accounts for change entry, classification and reuse, ambiguity governance and shared-interface migration in SPEC_METHOD §§4, 5 and 7. Its additional instance premises are changing specifications during work, one product receiving reports of every kind, shared interfaces with several producers and consumers, and decisions taken under policy or reserved to human authority. Reported commitment standing is P0 recovered; P1, P2, P3, P4a and P6 independent; P4b derived from P0 and P2 assuming step-produced facts cannot be reacquired; P5 derived from P0 and P6 with an open-world premise.

grounding.quote:
Standing of
the commitments

concepts.label: Foundation-to-law change family

concepts.definition: The common entry operation for substantive change, regardless of whether a report is called a bug, feature request, issue, regression, operator finding, release blocker or scenario failure. It determines substance, affected product boundary and scope, lawful class, constitutional re-entry, downstream repricing/rederivation/reproof including evidence selection S_Δ over impact cover I(Δ), and whether declared release scope holds or its plan needs repricing.

grounding.quote: Intake triage determines six things:

concepts.label: Universal intake triage

concepts.definition: A declared change state, with a minimum six-class domain: goal_reprice changes bounded work-wave focus, re-entering Goals and flowing through Intent, Product, Requirements, Design, Code and Evidence where deeper constitutional truth changes; intent_reprice changes direction or scope, entering Intent then Product, Requirements, Design, Code and Evidence; product_reprice changes current product realisation with stable directional intent, entering Product then Requirements, Design, Code and Evidence; requirement_reprice changes constitutional truth with stable project direction, entering Requirements then Design, Code and Evidence; design_reframe changes realisation structure with stable active intent and requirement truth, entering Design then Code and Evidence; realization_refactor changes local code, configuration or attributes with no intended constitutional or structural change, entering only the realised surface, flowing nowhere upstream and requiring proof of no upstream drift.

grounding.quote: | `realization_refactor` | local code, configuration or attribute change with no intended constitutional or structural change | the realised surface only | nothing upstream; it must prove no upstream drift |

The minimum lawful change classes, each with its re-entry point and the

concepts.definition: One reusable intake computation, produced by an explicitly selected source, worksite or qualification capability over the exact request and desired outcome; known targets and effects; operation grant and work lifetime; product definition and governing basis; baseline and available candidate; declared relations; accepted design and trace bindings; evidence and applicable rules. Its ordered stages are authority traversal, public delta, accepted-design coverage and rule-determined treatment.

grounding.quote:
C denotes reproducible facts and declared rule
application; J denotes residual semantic or materiality judgment; O denotes

A sprint is a bounded execution-control surface, not a new layer in the

concepts.definition: The substrate-neutral context urn:stdo:bounded-context:ambiguity-governance governs progressive narrowing: goals narrow active priority/work-wave focus; intent direction/scope; product realisation shape/terms; requirements constitutional obligations; tenant or stack binding executable realisation class; design structural interpretation; implementation local detail. That admission makes an operation

concepts.definition: Software lineage distinguishes substrate, development product, source project, release cut, product, install, artifact and product definition, whose definitions and governing rules are assigned to FOUNDATIONS §2. the product definition is the source project's present-tense

concepts.definition: Any shared contract or carrier materially governing runtime closure, reporting/status truth, topology/frame progression, proof/qualification outcome, event/projection semantics, identity/binding resolution or provider/resolver behaviour. A change capable of altering how multiple surfaces decide current truth is a core-interface change.

grounding.quote:
If changing the
interface can alter how multiple surfaces decide what is true now, it is a
core interface change

concepts.label: Core interface

conditions: A change alters a load-bearing contract, carrier, resolver, provider, projection law, closure law or another shared interface on which multiple surfaces depend.
concepts.definition: Constitutional migration replaces shared authoritative truth across its declared affected scope. Product-slice promotion and complete migration closure are separate claims. An outcome's acceptance path is its full causal closure, including every admitted entrypoint, producer, consumer, resolver, fallback, shared state surface, event, projection and proof surface capable of changing, interpreting or closing it.

the work is handled as a constitutional migration, not as incremental
patching

For this rule the affected acceptance path is the full causal closure of
the outcome:

concepts.label: Constitutional migration

concepts.definition: Two lawful strategies exist: inside-out hard-break migration replaces authoritative source truth in place on the same implementation line, proceeding outward through breaks and repairs; fundamental re-adoption applies to a major rewrite intentionally rederived on a materially different runtime, carrier, type system, execution substrate or realisation tree, with prior implementation moved aside as reference. Bounded evolution is a rebuttable strategy-selection presumption, not a third strategy.
concepts.label: Constitutional migration strategies

concepts.definition: For inside-out migration, a wave is an ordered hard-break sequence over one interface family, not a mode permitting competing authority. Refactoring and migration are also described as transformation waves over mutable implementation surfaces.

grounding.quote: The migration wave is the ordered set of those breaks;

Refactor and migration should be understood as a transformation wave over
mutable
implementation surfaces

concepts.label: Migration and transformation wave

conditions: A project intentionally abandons a prior constitutional shape and rederives itself on a new branch, version line or methodology basis.
concepts.definition: A constitutional reset with controlled explicit adoption, not passive inheritance. Inherited constitutional material has adoption states adopted, superseded, deferred or orphaned. Inherited implementation has required classes carry_across, materially unchanged and intentionally readopted; redundant, no longer needed; and rewrite, still needed but rebuilt under new requirements and design.

grounding.quote: fundamental migration is controlled adoption, not passive preservation.

concepts.label: Fundamental migration and adoption domains

conditions: Construction is delegated to a probabilistic or agentic worker.

Candidate availability, assessment results and owner disposition accept/local_repair/re_enter/reject remain separate results. Preservation, progress and completion are distinct construction claims.

a candidate that is available or
assessed is not thereby accepted

concepts.label: Bounded construction step

concepts.definition: Evidence for constitutional and realisation claims. EVALUATION owns proof-target identity/adequacy, semantic/evidence/projection separation, assurance-boundary congruence and qualification; ASSURANCE owns verification layers, testing taxonomy, fixture/proof portability, test authority, scenario bundles, installed development proof and significant-path coverage.

grounding.quote:
The rules that govern how constitutional claims are proved in practice are

concepts.definition: One independent, project-owned HOW realisation of a product's WHAT, located by the product definition's tenant registry. A build tenant is one independent, project-owned HOW realisation of a

concepts.label: Build tenant

concepts.definition: The obligations stated by a product's WHAT, permitted outcomes, and rules for refining and composing realisation work.

The requirements calculus of a product is the set of obligations its
  WHAT states, the outcomes it permits, and its rules for refining and
  composing the work that realises it.

concepts.label: Requirements calculus

concepts.definition: Declared executable operations, their composition laws, permitted transformations, effects and resource behaviour insofar as material to obligations.

grounding.quote:
A computational calculus is a declared set of executable operations,
  with the laws by which they compose, the transformations they permit,

concepts.label: Computational calculus

concepts.definition: Concrete means performing operations: technology stack, human process comprising people, roles, documents, communication channels and decision procedures, or both. A generic procedure has execution-environment-independent scope; operation kind identifies what is done, such as construct, assess, relay, record, measure or decide, together with required authority. Actor identity, author identity and operation kind are distinct.

grounding.quote:
An execution environment is the concrete means that performs those

concepts.label: Execution environment and operation kinds

conditions: Applies to every product built with the described method.

It is declared in existing design/realisation surfaces and design decisions, requires no additional carrier, and is distinct from a registry entry that merely locates the tenant.

grounding.quote:
A tenant's build-tenant binding has two parts: its calculus binding,

  execution binding, from that computational calculus to its execution
  environment.

concepts.label: Build-tenant binding

concepts.definition: The algorithmic, informational and computational accounts of construction remain separate across both bindings. A mapping between accounts is a transformation requiring stated preservation, licensing law, exactness or approximation, adequacy relation and end-to-end bound; the binding identifies joined accounts and environment-specific preservation evidence.

grounding.quote:
The
   binding keeps the three accounts apart. A mapping from one account to
   another is a transformation:

concepts.label: Three construction accounts

concepts.definition: An authored provenance ledger describing disposition of rc.2 SPEC_METHOD rows and selected DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD and POSTING_GUIDE rows. It reports conservation, proposed supersession pending product-owner acceptance, relocated ownership, generalisation and new law. grounding.quote:
nothing here is

grounding.quote:
Goals are
not the durable unit of execution tracking

concepts.label: Ticket-model goals

conditions: Work needs independent durable identity, including feature work, bugs, spikes and chores.

Each ticket is one durable record,
one markdown file being the default carrier;

A decision recorded in a

concepts.label: Comment post

an execution contract is the current
admitted execution function for one run.

The definition locates these carriers and

Each sprint manifest records at least `id`, `title`, `status`, `goal`,

Optional planned and cancelled states do not replace close review.

grounding.quote:
The minimum sprint status model is `active`, `closing`, `closed` and
`superseded`

concepts.label: Sprint status domain

concepts.definition: Explicitly recorded local deferred compliance held by a sprint. Potential eligible classes, only when governing method permits, include screenshots/walkthrough capture, visual review, accessibility cleanup, replay proof for product-meaningful UI interactions, design wording, trace and local realisation cleanup. Escrow is not acceptance or silent debt.

grounding.quote:
Deferred compliance is not
silent debt: it is escrow held by the sprint,

concepts.label: Sprint compliance escrow

grounding.quote:
Each consumer applies the rule and decides nothing the owning section does
not (P2, P6).

constraints.statement: Family consequences and consumers add no decisions beyond their owning rules. The member's domain/policy choices are the six classes and four procedures; C/J/O annotations, four-stage order and named C inputs; sprint statements/triggers; ambiguity narrowing order, major/micro distinction and two operation identities; migration strategies, evolution presumption, old-path classes and inside-out order; and inherited-implementation classes. REFERENCE_FRAME owns applicable frame selection; project policy owns ambiguity risk appetite; profiles decide domain suitability of escrow; the affected product's human authority selects fundamental re-adoption. Listed consumers apply these rules without acquiring additional authority.
constraints.uncertainty: External owning and consuming loci are not fully supplied.

conditions: Any substantive intake, irrespective of its report label.

grounding.quote:
No bug, feature, issue or other intake bypasses this triage by going
straight to code, tests or release handling.

constraints.statement: Perform all six intake determinations before code, tests or release handling. Diagnose among defective realisation, inadequate governing requirement/design, inaccurate predictive model and insufficient observation; route each supported repair to its cause's owner, not by intake label. Severity and priority follow TICKETS policy; a bug list projects existing work state. This applies ACTIVATION's diagnosis relation and creates no second relation.
constraints.uncertainty: The referenced severity/priority policies and full impact-cover definition are unavailable.

conditions: Triangulating a failure.

grounding.quote:
a counterexample that
one frame finds survives the join, and a frame planned and not applied
leaves its diagnosis open, never ruled out.

constraints.statement: Use the smallest sufficient applicable configuration of reference frames over the same subject and basis. Each tests candidate diagnoses against its own material workspace variables, governing relations and evidence; combine results to constrain supported cause, retain unresolved alternatives/uncertainty and identify the smallest sufficient lawful repair scope. Exposure frame need not contain cause; renamed repetition adds no causal evidence. Each result retains its evaluated diagnosis predicate; counterexamples survive conjunction, and planned unapplied frames leave diagnoses open. Apply counterexample localisation where required. No reviewer count or new review round is prescribed; required independence persists. Diagnosis grants no repair effects and proves no need to change governing meaning; correction under sufficient existing law remains possible.
constraints.uncertainty: Detailed frame applicability, conjunction and localisation rules are referenced externally.

conditions: Substantive work begins.

grounding.quote:
a declared class is never combined as an
evaluation result,

constraints.statement: Record change intent, class, re-entry point and triage time wherever substantive work starts; TICKETS §4 records class on the carrier. Re-entry below Goals requires an explicit assertion that no upstream constitutional surface changes. Missing declared class is process drift. A changed governing relation is accepted only at its owner; acceptance inside the acting frame violates the rule regardless of delta size. Classes are declared states with no core-value mapping, never evaluation results. A consuming evaluation returns its own predicate/core value. A layer-naming close classification is a result for its own predicate carrying the re-entry class as domain outcome; realization_refactor never substitutes for satisfied proof of no upstream drift.
constraints.uncertainty: The referenced close-review result mapping is not supplied.

grounding.quote:
Its output identifies the producer and procedure
revision, the inputs, the result, the scope, the source routes, the
reproduction relation, the unknowns and the invalidators.

constraints.statement: Record producer/procedure revision, inputs, result, scope, source routes, reproduction relation, unknowns and invalidators. Missing candidate/evidence is an input state, not proof of no change. Expose stages in order: (1) traverse explicit source, ownership, dependency, composition and projection declarations from targets/effects; record reached layers/owners, exact bases, changed/unchanged/unknown relations, traversed edges and unresolved frontier, including root/authority/grant changes despite equal public bytes; absent edges prove no irrelevance and uncertain/undeclared materiality stays J; (2) enumerate the complete relevant serialised member universe under owning declarations/projections, including helper/generated dependencies, reporting additions/removals and all retained changed typed values/bytes with exact before/after values; (3) join changed bytes/relations to explicit accepted scope, traces and acceptance evidence, distinguishing covered/missing/stale/ambiguous/outside-scope; filenames, listed artifacts and digests alone prove no coverage, and semantic sufficiency stays J; (4) apply only declared rules with sufficient facts, record owners/matched predicates/consequences and expose smallest lawful re-entry, next action, evidence/assessment, reserved ruling and carrier lifetime, preserving conflicts/missing premises. Labels and filenames cannot choose a route; settled rules do not warrant inventing J.

exceptions: A rename preserves identity only when the owner supplies an identity-preserving relation.

grounding.quote:
A rename is removal plus addition unless its
   owner supplies an identity-preserving relation.

a
classification fact is never combined as an evaluation result,

constraints.statement: Default rename treatment is removal plus addition. Missing candidate, incomplete enumeration, ambiguous identity or unavailable projection leaves affected delta unknown; equal membership does not imply equal values. Relation states changed/unchanged/unknown, identity states added/removed/retained-with-changed-value, and evidence states covered/missing/stale/ambiguous/outside-scope are computed facts with no core-value mapping. A consuming evaluation has its own predicate/core result and retains consumed unknowns; covered or unchanged cannot substitute for satisfied.

grounding.quote:
Candidate
behaviour cannot author its own target law

constraints.statement: Public delta/nonconformance alone does not require changing governing law. If law remains sufficient for the authorised outcome, reject or locally repair the candidate within grant. Re-enter the actual owner when an explicitly selected desired outcome requires changed meaning or applicable assessment establishes governing insufficiency. C establishes this only from sufficient declared premises; unresolved intended meaning/necessity is J and reserved decisions remain O. Unknown treatment withholds dependent reliance/promotion, not unrelated authorised work. Update affected C before new evidence supports dependent effects/promotion. Correct a mistaken route at the smallest affected owner while preserving original cause, attempted subject, observed effect state and valid progress. Retry requires applicable outcome, authority and safe-recovery conditions. completion_unknown, or not_effected without an established end, is not no effect and must be reconciled under ACTIVATION §5 before retry or dependent action.
constraints.uncertainty: Full effect and reconciliation semantics are externally owned.

conditions: A new role, conversation or resumption proposes reuse, or relevant inputs/basis/observations change.

grounding.quote:
the wider frontier is recomputed where
independence is unproved

constraints.statement: Reuse valid C after checking exact applicability rather than repeating unchanged reconstruction. Changes to request, candidate, owner/root relation, projection, design trace/acceptance, applied rule, configuration or material evidence invalidate affected C claims before reliance; changed basis and declared revising observation likewise invalidate. Preserve predecessor/successor identities, changed inputs, surviving facts and affected J dependencies; recompute wider frontier where independence is unproved. ACTIVATION §7 owns reuse/invalidation; TICKETS §7 owns existing carriers and recorded J/O continuity.
constraints.uncertainty: The full external reuse and continuity rules are not supplied.

conditions: Within the declared change span.

grounding.quote:
No gate closes while the affected active surfaces are internally
inconsistent

constraints.statement: Closure requires proof that upstream remains sufficient for downstream, downstream artifacts do not contradict active upstream truth, and tests/qualification prove active intended behaviour rather than stale precedent. Missing proof keeps the change open despite a locally correct artifact. A material counterexample to a mandatory constraint, required judgment/ruling without a closed result, or evidence-unaddressed obligation blocks closure and remains recorded by kind. Review events, passing aggregates, completed artifacts and status changes cannot replace the conjunction of declared obligations with valid evidence. TICKETS records carrier state. During ticketed code/test mismatch, implementation is evidence without authority; reconcile through admitted ticket, triage, lawful re-entry and governing requirement/design/module/carrier/closure surface, subject to TICKETS test-case and ASSURANCE test-authority rules.
constraints.uncertainty: The full owning closure/reuse and test-authority rules are external.

grounding.quote: A lawful sprint states at least:

constraints.statement: A sprint cannot create, supersede, weaken or override constitutional authority. It states served goal/work wave, upstream authority dependencies, admitted scope, excluded product/requirement/design/runtime/data-contract/governance boundaries, expected change classes, any deferrable local proof/compliance debt, closure trigger/law and close-discovered debt paydown/repricing path. Deferral optimisation is lawful only while cost remains local, visible, bounded and repayable; escrow satisfies no method, release or product closure until paid down, explicitly accepted under governing method, or repriced upstream. Close review compares accumulated work/evidence with governing authority, classifies every gap, accepts compliant work, opens local-debt paydown and escalates drift through lawful class. Discovered product-truth change is not authorised to land by the manifest; split, escalate, reprice or carry explicit paydown. TICKETS owns mechanics; a profile may define domain suitability of escrow.

conditions: Substantive work begins.

grounding.quote:
The triage fields are required wherever substantive work begins; a ticket
per change is not

constraints.statement: Select the smallest lawful carrier according to required lifetime and preserve required triage fields regardless of carrier. No ticket-per-change obligation is imposed.
constraints.uncertainty: The complete smallest-lawful-carrier selection rule in TICKETS §5 is outside the supplied excerpt.

conditions: A substantive intake arrives or a feature is introduced/changed.

grounding.quote:
only then treat the work as implementation, repricing or
release-bound change.

develop code under the selected design relation and reconcile
design, implementation and tests before promotion or closure;

constraints.statement: First triage/classify, identify lawful re-entry and affected downstream consistency span, then treat work as implementation/repricing/release-bound. For features, update Goals when bounded work wave or overriding concerns change; Intent when purpose/scope changes; Product when realisation, terms, boundaries or end-state shape changes. Make invariant requirements an explicit decomposition of Product, include lifecycle obligations or named lifecycle ambiguity gaps, and categorise every new/changed requirement. Establish/update governing structural HOW. Under an applicable design profile, co-evolution requires its predicate; otherwise accept the smallest causally closed affected design set before retained implementation establishes unresolved, contradictory or materially nonequivalent relations. Outside that profile, co-evolution is permitted only without unresolved material design decisions; otherwise accept affected design before retained implementation establishes it, with ADRs a valid form. Write scenarios for capability claims requiring operational proof and appropriate other evidence for non-capability requirements. Prefer declarative problem/acceptance expression before imperative mechanism. Check support across Goals→Intent→Product→Requirements→Design→implementation; record/govern major boundary ambiguity under declared risk appetite; develop under selected design, reconcile design/code/tests before promotion/closure, and use events, projection and delta to test continuing requirement satisfaction.
constraints.uncertainty: The design profile's co-evolution predicate is referenced but not defined here.

conditions: Bootstrapping a project, repricing a requirement surface, or responding to a real-use-case gap, as applicable.

grounding.quote:
then write the scenario as the first
substantive project artifact for the gap

constraints.statement: For bootstrap/requirement repricing: resolve Product, verify exact installed basis, load declared bootstrap entrypoint, then Goals or bound current-work-wave equivalent; perform Goals→Intent and confirm/write Intent, then Intent→Product and confirm/write current Product bridge; gather relevant constitutional requirement sources, derive Product→Requirements and write the live requirement surface. Use individual files or grouped families according to clarity and avoidance of monolithic sprawl. Establish sole live requirement authority before design/code; prefer declarative structure over procedural workaround; record remaining major ambiguity before downstream realisation; only after the surface exists should downstream work be treated as constitutionally grounded. For a real-use-case gap: triage/classify first, then make the scenario the first substantive project artifact, analyse cause while retaining evidence-unseparated alternatives, and flow forward from the selected class's layer. Write new Goals/Intent only when work wave, direction or scope changes. Bug, feature, failed-test, release-blocker and operator sources do not bypass this order.
constraints.uncertainty: PRODUCT_DEFINITION §12 bootstrap details are not supplied; the gap revision is reported as pending acceptance in the disposition ledger.

grounding.quote:
Ambiguity detection is
mandatory; blocking is policy

constraints.statement: Profile runtime shorthands remain in their profile context absent explicit import/translation. Always surface/govern major ambiguity; never conceal it in informal operator judgment, precedent or model choice. At each major boundary record remaining/new major ambiguity, affected invariant/asset/decision boundary, any decision when proceeding, and outcome resolved/carried/escalated/blocked. For the predicate that declared ambiguity is resolved on exact basis, only resolved is satisfied; later claims cannot treat carried/escalated/blocked as resolution. Policy and declared risk appetite set probabilistic handling versus admitted human adjudication, with ambiguity and decision recorded in either case. Relaying, recording or executing does not itself adjudicate; a person deciding/carrying ambiguity under policy without adjudication admission follows probabilistic-processing policy/recording. ACTIVATION hard stops hold regardless of risk appetite. The aim is visible governed progressive constraint, not elimination of all ambiguity before any work. An unanswered lifecycle phase is a recorded gap, never silent absence.
constraints.uncertainty: Exact core values for non-resolved outcomes, hard-stop classes and lifecycle-phase rules are externally defined.

grounding.quote:
it is not an exact dependency, evidence or constitutional
basis and cannot silently change a consumer selection.

a calculus, its interpretation of a subject and its carrier encoding keep
independent content identities, judgments, supersession relations and
proof obligations,

constraints.statement: Only immutable v<version>-rc.<n> is an exact operative release identifier. A cut belongs to release metadata/process evaluation, not live specification. Mutable v<version> is discovery only, cannot be exact dependency/evidence/constitutional basis and cannot silently alter selection. Shared realisation surfaces should describe current truth by role, boundary and status rather than release-line labels. Calculus, subject interpretation and carrier encoding retain independent content identities, judgments, supersession relations and proof obligations; none automatically constitutes an independently released product. RELEASE owns publication, advancement, release criteria/process and successor conservation; PRODUCT_DEFINITION owns the project's single constitutional surface/version boundary.
constraints.uncertainty: Referenced release and constitutional-surface rules are not fully supplied.

conditions: Adopting or propagating a reusable method change.

grounding.quote:
a
consumer selects a complete released version rather than mixing members from different cuts

constraints.statement: Preserve the single stated authority-causality chain. An executable tool, runtime, carrier schema or assurance implementation requires its own Product authorisation; accompanying a method lesson does not admit it. Other standards consume admitted law by reference. Consumers explicitly select one complete released version and may not mix members from different cuts. The chain imposes neither intake workflow nor artifact set.

conditions: A core-interface change occurs.
exceptions: Bounded product-slice proof remains subject to the path-relative promotion rule.

grounding.quote:
change the authoritative core contract first; ban bridge code for that
contract family as an authoritative surface; audit every producer and every
consumer of the impacted interface; migrate each producer and consumer to
the new contract;

constraints.statement: Handle the work as constitutional migration: change authoritative core contract first, forbid authoritative bridge code for the family, audit every producer and consumer, migrate each to the new contract and pursue every downstream effect until no superseded closure law remains. Run complete migration-closure proof only after the wave completes. Split writers/readers, authoritative compatibility aliases, projections as second truth and green tests over split architecture may not be declared complete.

conditions: Selecting a strategy for core-interface or major implementation replacement work.
exceptions: Evolution does not require an unsafe or constitutionally inadmissible predecessor, nor retention of an implementation/public mechanism explicitly superseded by Product authority.

grounding.quote:
Fundamental re-adoption requires explicit selection by the human authority
owning the affected product boundary.

constraints.statement: Where both strategies are lawful/feasible and a working predecessor can reach the admitted outcome without competing/ambiguous authority, presume bounded evolution on the supported product path, rebuttably, conserving accepted predecessor semantics and feedback. Evolution involving a core interface uses inside-out hard breaks. Fundamental re-adoption requires explicit selection by the affected Product boundary's human authority, comparing value, feedback latency, authority risk, reversibility, total cost and retained predecessor semantics and stating a bounded abort/re-entry condition. Scale or architectural preference alone cannot select it.

conditions: Either strategy; promotion of an affected outcome or deferral of superseded-family material.
exceptions: Residual material outside the promoted path may be deferred only under all stated deferment conditions.

grounding.quote:
If the same request, fact, identity, state or projection is
admissible to old and new authority, authority is competing and promotion
blocks

constraints.statement: No proxy/partial implementation substitutes for the new contract in any acceptance path; no bridge/fallback remains silently authoritative. Outcome promotion requires one unambiguous authority across full causal closure, not just a successful trace. Old/new admissibility for the same request, fact, identity, state or projection blocks promotion. Outside-path residuals may be deferred only when explicitly non-authoritative for the promoted outcome or governing an explicitly specified disjoint product/compatibility scope with deterministic routing, unable to falsify current/retained claims, and carrying bounded migration/qualification/release disposition. Tests detect leaks and provide proof, not a migration plan. Intermediate promotion requires singular path authority plus lawful residual deferral; it closes neither migration nor retirement obligations. Slice identity/acceptance derives from Product and every causally applicable live requirement, accepted design and retained predecessor claim; ticket/review wording cannot narrow this. Open migration does not renew exhausted slice growth authority. Admitted removal/demotion/closure-proof work may continue within its existing bound without claiming further product progress; further material producer/consumer growth needs another still-live §3 basis, not ticket activity.
constraints.uncertainty: The full §3 growth/admission basis is not supplied.

conditions: Every core-interface migration.

grounding.quote:
Every old path is then classified as `remove`,
`replace`, `re-authorize` or `temporary scaffolding`.

constraints.statement: Explicitly declare exact affected scope; every excluded/disjoint product or compatibility scope and deterministic routing; new authoritative contract; superseded contract/surface; new authoritative closure law; full sets of old/new producers and consumers; and every derived projection, report, status and proof surface. Classify every old path remove, replace, re-authorize or temporary scaffolding. Temporary scaffolding is lawful only when explicitly non-authoritative and scheduled for removal before closure.

conditions: A core-interface migration.
exceptions: An explicit live-product compatibility feature whose path is intentionally specified, explicitly bounded and identified as compatibility rather than current native truth.

grounding.quote:
The only lawful exception is an explicit compatibility
feature retained as part of the live product,

constraints.statement: No authoritative compatibility alias, silent fallback identity law, bridge accepted as new contract, old authoritative reader/writer for an outcome governed by the new contract, or proxy/partial implementation presented as completion may remain.
constraints.uncertainty: The compatibility exception remains constrained by singular authority and disjoint routing in the migration-options section.

grounding.quote:
Projections, reports, status views and topology views may reflect the
authoritative carrier; they do not become a second closure surface

constraints.statement: Projection/report/status/topology views remain downstream of the authoritative carrier. Migration is incomplete if runtime, reporting, topology and proof can disagree on closure by consuming different carriers/laws; if a projection independently closes while the carrier remains open; or if the carrier closes while a projection still depends on older law.

conditions: Inside-out hard-break migration.
exceptions: Downstream exploration is allowed only as isolated non-authoritative work before source publication/admission.

grounding.quote:
A
downstream projection ticket does not close while the source-carrier
ticket it depends on is still open.

constraints.statement: Proceed outward from new authoritative source carrier. Discover the full best-guess interface family before using proof for closure, including producers, consumers, projections, prompts, reports, wrappers, replay, ingest, bootstrap and proof paths. Authoritative producer/source work precedes downstream consumer/projection/prompt/dossier/report/review hardening. Downstream exploration cannot land in public runtime, projection, prompt, report or proof entrypoints before source publication/admission. Dependent projection tickets cannot close while source-carrier tickets remain open; explicit dependency direction must expose source-to-read-model order.

conditions: Each inside-out hard break.
exceptions: New affected interfaces remain in the same wave unless explicitly repriced upward; specified, deterministically routed, non-overlapping product/compatibility scopes may coexist while migration remains open.

grounding.quote:
run negative proof that the
severed seam is rejected rather than merely unused.

constraints.statement: Publish/admit the new deepest authoritative source carrier; sever one old authoritative seam and keep it broken; repair outward to consumers, then projections, prompts/reports and proof surfaces; prove the severed seam is rejected, not merely unused. Tests may discover missed interfaces but never replace the inventory. Re-enabling a seam through wrappers, fallback, projections or prompts is a migration defect. The wave permits no competing/ambiguous dual truth for the same request, fact, identity, state or projection.

exceptions: Bounded slice proof establishes only the exact intermediate outcome permitted by path-relative promotion.

grounding.quote:
Complete migration-closure proof is not valid while producers and
consumers are split across old and new contracts.

constraints.statement: Complete closure proof follows migration and is invalid during split old/new producer-consumer contracts. Bridge-dependent green tests do not count, and local green tests cannot overrule split architecture. Slice proof cannot establish migration closure. Per-break proof must show rejection or fail-closed behaviour of the old seam before downstream hardening counts as progress.

conditions: Claiming completion across declared affected scope.
exceptions: A superseded mechanism may be retained for a distinct supported responsibility satisfying the retention relation.

grounding.quote:
A core interface migration is complete across its declared affected scope
only when every authoritative producer writes the new contract;

constraints.statement: Completion requires every authoritative producer writing and consumer reading the new contract, retired superseded authoritative paths unless justified by distinct responsibility, projections downstream of common truth, one runtime/reporting/topology/proof closure law, and no temporary scaffolding in acceptance. Until then the wave remains active. Every retained superseded mechanism must identify current supported obligation, owner, purpose, execution scope and material cost. Temporary compatibility/comparison needs expiry/removal trigger; tests, oracle labels and nominal demotion do not justify duplicate production responsibility. Required cold reconstruction or independent test oracles may fulfil enduring distinct obligations without invented expiry. Identify surviving owners for surviving obligations; no governing basis means no replacement guard required. Retirement in a closed affected cone need not await unrelated whole-product closure. An accepted slice names what it closes, visibly leaves migration open and cannot project acceptance as migration, qualification or release closure.

conditions: Fundamental migration is selected.
constraints.statement: Prior constitutional documents become source material without new-line authority. Every retained statement/requirement/design choice/guide rule requires explicit readoption and should land in its proper Goals/Intent/Product/Requirements/Design/guide/template layer. Old code/design are reference only unless explicitly rederived/readopted; absence means not yet adopted, never automatic authority. Classify every inherited module, interface, carrier, projection and proof surface before reuse; unclassified implementation is defective and blocks closure as the family consumer row states. Declare migration line, establish fresh method/Goals/Intent/Product/Requirements/Design surfaces, move prior implementation aside if necessary to prevent ambient authority, classify constitutional and implementation material in their separate domains, copy only intentionally retained material and derive downstream work from new surfaces. carry_across is explicit readoption, not automatic copying. Direct runtime/projection/prompt/proof/review dependence on the sideways line is bridge debt; partial target proxies depending on it cannot lawfully close. Creating a new constitutional surface is supersession, not silent mutation of the old one.

conditions: Classifying inherited requirements or other constitutional material.

grounding.quote: The two relate as follows, and are not one classification:

constraints.statement: Constitutional adoption decisions and legacy live-requirement standing are different classifications. Adopted requirements enter live surface as Active, or Deferred if explicitly adopted as not-yet-operative obligations. Deferred adoption means absent from live surface, no legacy classification and no authority until adoption. Superseded/orphaned inherited requirements take Superseded/Orphaned with the external table's meanings. Other inherited constitutional material retains the four adoption classes. These are declared surface states and do not supply RELEASE §9 predecessor-claim disposition.
constraints.uncertainty: The source-disposition ledger describes these classifications differently; the discrepancy remains explicit in a residual. Full legacy and successor-disposition meanings are not supplied.

conditions: Wave in flight or landed across declared scope, respectively.
exceptions: Specified, deterministically routed, non-overlapping product/compatibility scopes may coexist while migration stays visibly open; a landed compatibility feature must be named as current behaviour, specification-justified, bounded and intentionally tested.

grounding.quote: mixed old and new operative models are not a stable end state.

constraints.statement: During a wave, temporary mixed implementation is allowed only below the current break boundary as explicitly non-authoritative plumbing; adapters/scaffolds must be named, bounded and outside acceptance. Prior-model traces cannot supply competing authority for the same request/fact/identity/state/projection. On landing, only the new operative surface remains live for affected scope; erase prior operative paths from the live product, retaining journey only in version control, events and superseded records. Apart from the explicit compatibility exception, deletion rather than passive preservation is required.

grounding.quote:
the selected outcome of a step is the product
outcome, prerequisite or experiment of §3; the owning relations are the
chain's layers; the re-entry conditions are the change classes of §4.

constraints.statement: Selected computational relations come from the executing tenant's calculus; actors/tools/processes belong to its environment and time/spend/resource limits to its execution binding. Generic step outcome binds to §3 product outcome/prerequisite/experiment, owners to chain layers and re-entry to change classes, without adding a construction relation. Configuration derives construction/assessment/disposition frames and return consumer from task operations, dependencies, capabilities and assurance; no new role inventory/coordinator/sequence is imposed. A configured coordinator acts only within decision grant and selects authorised next action. Executive/Worker/Reviewer configuration governs only where its profile is selected. Priority weighs outcome, likelihood, impact, reversibility, dependency and delayed feedback cost. Probability waives no authority/integrity/safety/retained release claim/hard stop; unsupported numeric confidence stays unresolved. Default priority exposes/advances the smallest supported path and highest-value likely failures. Displacing defensive/prerequisite work identifies claim, evidence, bounded effort, return condition and product consequence. This is priority, not global sequence/runtime. Early smallest-real-path delivery and widening by uncertainty/interface reach/failure impact are heuristics, not law; a passing path proves only exercised relations.
constraints.uncertainty: Full ACTIVATION step, admission, resource, proportionality and configuration rules and baseline profile remain external.

conditions: A realisation claim.
constraints.statement: Evidence required by TICKETS §7 closure includes authority trace, realisation proof, negative proof where drift is plausible, and present-tense residual open pressure. This adds no second closure condition. The source attributes this proof compression to an rc.2 compression artifact while stating no rc.2 body states it.
constraints.uncertainty: Tier-1 proof laws, ASSURANCE rules and full TICKETS closure condition are not supplied.

exceptions: A superseded ADR may be deleted only when explicitly retired.

grounding.quote:
Each ADR explicitly includes `Status:` (`active`, `superseded` or
`retired`);
ADRs are append-only history.

constraints.statement: Each ADR explicitly includes Status active/superseded/retired; Implements requirement identifiers; Derives from intent identifier or motivating strategy; Supersedes prior ADR/doctrine; Superseded by successor when superseded; and Retained special case when earlier behaviour is intentionally retained. Name any operational mechanism named by the requirement; immediately reprice event-contract ADR when requirements expand event taxonomy. Superseded records remain with status and successor link until explicit retirement. If shared/cross-tenant scope narrows to one tenant, move the ADR to that tenant's design surface and record the move in supersession history. Store at closest owning design surface, never comments, generated views, runtime archives or requirement folders. Filename convention is ADR-<local-id>-short-slug.md with local ID unique in owning adrs/ directory. Product tenant registry records tenant identity and locations for every layout. This section owns lifecycle/location rules formerly only in templates; templates refer to it.

grounding.quote:
no choice of environment removes a required human decision or
   a required independent assessment.

constraints.statement: Each tenant owns bindings, realisation and evidence while WHAT retains meaning. Selection of stack, human process or mixture remains inside requirements calculus. Required human decisions and independent assessments cannot be removed. Author identity, actor identity and operation kind determine none of one another: authorship does not select environment, one actor may hold several operation-specific grants, and identity grants no authority. Human participation does not itself confer adjudication; a reserved human decision belongs to the person admitted by governing authority, not another participant. A generic procedure and its projections require code/event stream/full-history reconstruction only where governing obligations or selected binding require them; an adequate current-record/direct-observation human process is permitted otherwise. Weakening an obligation requires change to WHAT at its owner, never tenant choice. Binding changes undergo triage/classification; material stack/execution ambiguity is recorded/governed; construction runs under the executing tenant's binding.
constraints.uncertainty: External independence and design rules are not fully supplied.

conditions: For obligations served by the binding; measures are required where selected obligations need them.

grounding.quote:
A resource claim without its unit or its boundary supports no
   conformance claim.

constraints.statement: Identify operations with inputs, outputs, effects and outcome values, mapping each outcome to exactly one core value; record intended external effects including uncertain completion under ACTIVATION Effects. Identify composition laws, permitted transformations, resource measures and conformance-relevant assumptions about actors/tools/availability/failure. Measure human effort, elapsed time, communication and machine resources where required; each measure states unit, counted boundary and start/stop. Measure selected context against binding-declared actor capacity under ACTIVATION §2. State activation time/spend/other limits and measurable units/boundaries in execution binding before the limited activation; configuration obtains resource limits and failure assumptions from that binding.
constraints.uncertainty: Core mappings, effect semantics, context measurement and resource-limit laws are externally defined.

grounding.quote:
the binding's conformance for that
   obligation is `falsified`;

constraints.statement: Requirements determine fitness; executor kind alone neither accepts nor rejects. Evidence must establish required meaning/constraints including authority, independence, failure and recovery. Each assessment has its predicate/core value; tenant conformance is their conjunction with all requirements obligations as coverage. Conforming tenants need not behave identically outside contract. Merging required independent assessments or substituting automation for a required human decision is a counterexample: binding conformance for that obligation is falsified and runs lack an applicable closed result for the lost assessment/decision. Matching outputs, lower cost and speed cannot discharge it. Categorical-structure preservation is a further Formal-fragment claim distinct from conformance. An a_c representation prescribes no executor; structural validation neither selects automation nor proves execution conformance, which needs separate evidence.
constraints.uncertainty: The full conformance conjunction, equivalence ladder and Formal fragment are not supplied.

grounding.quote:
replacing the
   executor of an operation while the calculus's laws hold changes the
   execution binding, not the calculus

This method prescribes none of these
mechanics.

constraints.statement: Reuse a computational calculus across tenants/environments wherever each binding satisfies and evidences its laws. Language/tool/team/person difference alone need not change calculus; executor substitution preserving laws changes execution binding. Keep algorithmic/informational/computational accounts separate; mappings must state and discharge preservation, licensing law and exactness or approximate adequacy/end-to-end bound under ACTIVATION refinement, using AC-013 if recorded in a_c. Project-local law or tenant design selects branches, copies, territories, review points and merge mechanics; the method imposes none of these mechanics, but TICKETS owns independent tenant ticket lifecycles and tenant-ticket review. Means do not become method machinery or require a parallel human-process method.
constraints.uncertainty: Referenced account definitions, transformation record and multitenant ticket rules are not supplied.

grounding.quote: proposed and pending the product owner's acceptance

grounding.quote:
it does not erase the need for paydown tickets when close review finds debt
that must survive past the sprint

constraints.statement: Operate under SPEC_METHOD and cited project surfaces; batch authority is not constitutional authority. Use tickets for cross-session identity and manifest-local entries for small changes whose independent value is only sprint traceability. Close by explicit sprint-close review, retaining required paydown tickets for debt that outlives the sprint.

conditions: Work arrives and execution is proposed.
constraints.statement: The described intended loop selects the smallest lawful lifetime carrier, drafts one run-scoped contract, validates and deterministically admits/rejects its classification under ACTIVATION admission, logs admitted basis into runtime/event truth, assembles prompts from admitted law rather than raw phrasing and checks closure against the same contract. grounding.quote: Ticket completion requires every closure-bearing milestone to be accepted;

constraints.statement: Milestone acceptance proves only its bounded declared claim; design acceptance does not satisfy implementation, installed proof, qualification or release. Every closure-bearing milestone must satisfy TICKETS §7 condition-based closure for its own claim before ticket completion. Optional/deferred work requires explicit disposition and owner. Commentary/generated summaries cannot mutate milestone or ticket truth.

their
absence from the project tree is not absence from the governing method.

constraints.statement: Resolve TICKETS and POSTING_GUIDE through the applicable Product definition's exact shared installed basis; missing local files do not mean absent governing method. Bindings locate goals; optional sprints; ticketing.tickets.lanes.backlog, .active and .completed; and comments. The definition does not own ticket/comment content. ACTIVE_TASKS.md is not separately mandatory; generated boards remain projections unless the explicit exclusive rebinding exception applies.
constraints.uncertainty: PRODUCT_DEFINITION binding validation and TICKETS §7 one-truth rules are not fully supplied.

conditions: Substituting or extending a work carrier.

grounding.quote:
Another carrier is not required to reproduce its folders, but
it preserves the same ticket authority and refusal laws

constraints.statement: The selected durable local-file model remains valid. Alternative carriers need not reproduce folders but must preserve one durable record, ticket authority and refusal laws. Generated boards remain projections; an authoritative external tracker requires explicit Product-definition rebinding with no rival. Growth does not change authority/refusal laws.
constraints.uncertainty: The complete referenced refusal laws in TICKETS §§3–4 are not supplied.

grounding.quote:
Each sprint has one durable manifest record; the default carrier is one
markdown file.

constraints.statement: Maintain one durable manifest per sprint. A different bound carrier preserves identity, required fields, history, closure law and one-truth relation. For local files, a stable ID and short slug are recommended, illustrated by SPRINT-2026-04-30-process-navigator.md and SPRINT-2026-05-12-dashboard-density.md.

grounding.quote:
`paydown_policy` states how
deferred debt becomes accepted, ticketed, repriced or removed during close
review

constraints.statement: authority_refs names upstream goals/intent/product/requirements/design or other governing surfaces. excluded_boundaries names prohibited changes, with typical examples product truth, data contracts, runtime semantics, governance/closure law, public carrier shape and release criteria; examples are not a mandatory exhaustive exclusion list. deferred_compliance identifies intentionally close-deferred local proof/review/accessibility/screenshot/walkthrough/test/design-wording/trace cleanup. paydown_policy states close-review acceptance, ticketing, repricing or removal of deferred debt.

conditions: Admitting sprint work.
exceptions: Manifest-local iterations may rely on the sprint's declared class only while within scope and excluded boundaries.

grounding.quote: It may not batch away intake triage:

constraints.statement: Admission requires a reviewable manifest with bounded scope, cited authority, expected classes, explicit exclusions, closure law, non-closure conditions and deferred-compliance paydown policy. Repeated closure criteria may be batched, but substantive included tickets still record lawful change_class and re_entry_point; batching cannot remove triage.

conditions: Deferring local compliance proof.

A sprint may defer local compliance proof only when the manifest names the
deferred proof or cleanup class;

It satisfies no method/release/product closure until paid down, accepted or repriced.
